newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan offshore futures "positive" - central bank.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan offshore futures "positive" - central bank.

text.p: Taiwan central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong has voiced support for controversial Taiwan stock index futures launched on January 9 by exchanges in Chicago and Singapore, calling them positive, officials said on Wednesday.
"We also hold a positive view and we will soon express this viewpoint to the finance ministry," Sheu was quoted by a spokesman as telling a Taipei business seminar.

Sheu's comment echoed one by Finance Minister Paul Chiu, who on the eve of the contracts' launch called them positive. The Securities and Exchange Commission has taken a harder line, forbidding local investors to trade the offshore contracts.
